title: Import any repository
description: Imported by REPAIR-0 from runtime/executive/mission-imports/2026-10-22-diagnosis-and-paid-repair.json. Source ticket: IMPORT-ANY.
objective: KoreLumina imports a repository from any git host or an uploaded archive, in any language, records that it was imported (not built in KoreLumina), and says honestly which analyses apply to it.
risks: Private repositories need an access token; it must live only in Runtime's secret store and never be written to project files, logs or reports.
Advisory checks for non-JavaScript ecosystems need an outside vulnerability database (for example OSV); running against it needs the owner's approval.
Archives from customers are untrusted: path traversal, symlinks and size bombs must be refused.

tasks.title: Import from any git host over HTTPS
acceptanceCriteria: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and self-hosted git URLs import
A private repository imports with a token the customer provides, and the token is never stored in the project or shown again

tasks.title: Import from an uploaded archive
acceptanceCriteria: Entries outside the project folder, symlinks out of it, and archives over the size limit are refused with a reason

tasks.title: Every project records its origin
acceptanceCriteria: A project is marked imported (with its source) or built in KoreLumina
Diagnosis and paid repair are offered only for imported projects

tasks.title: Detect the ecosystem of every package in the repository
acceptanceCriteria: Node, Python, Go, Rust, Java and Kotlin (Maven, Gradle), .NET, PHP, Ruby, Swift, Dart and Flutter, C and C++ (CMake) are recognised from their manifests
Anything else is reported as unrecognised, never guessed

tasks.title: Repository Intelligence analyses each recognised ecosystem
acceptanceCriteria: Dependency manifests and lockfiles are read for each recognised ecosystem
Secret and code risk scans run on every text file whatever the language
A category the engine cannot check for an ecosystem is reported as not checked and never counted as passing

validationPlan: One repository per recognised ecosystem imports and audits with no false build failure
